scripts.build: npm run check:deployment && sh apps/server/scripts/with-rust.sh sh apps/server/scripts/build.sh
scripts.check:deployment: sh apps/server/scripts/with-rust.sh cargo run --quiet --locked -p time-wise-server --example deployment -- check
scripts.deploy: sh apps/server/scripts/with-rust.sh cargo run --quiet --locked -p time-wise-server --example deployment -- deploy

AUTH_ORIGIN.description: Your canonical HTTPS origin, without a path. Configure its domain before using discovery. Authentication is disabled in this foundation.

CLIENT_PROFILE_IDS.description: JSON array of enabled desktop profile IDs. Use only profiles supported by your desktop build.

AUTH_DB.description: Deployment-owned D1 database. Preserve this database and its ID on redeployment. Authentication schema is added separately.
